subject: math
question: 求微分方程 $y' + x = \sqrt{x^{2} + y}$ 的通解.

steps.text:
分析 很难看出该方程属于哪一类可求解的方程. 若能将等式右端的函数分离变量, 方程的求解就容易了. 为此, 可作变量代换 $y = x^2 u$ .

令 $y = x^{2}u$ ，则 $y' = 2xu + x^{2}u'$ ，代入方程化为

$$
2 x u + x ^ {2} u ^ {\prime} + x = x \sqrt {1 + u}    ,    \text {即}   \frac {\mathrm{d} u}{\sqrt {1 + u} - 1 - 2 u} = \frac {\mathrm{d} x}{x}  .\tag{①}
$$

由于

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} u}{\sqrt {1 + u} - 1 - 2 u} & \stackrel {t = \sqrt {1 + u}} {=} - \int \frac {2 t \mathrm{d} t}{2 t ^ {2} - t - 1} = - \frac {1}{3} \int \left[ \frac {2}{t - 1} + \frac {1}{t + 1 / 2} \right] \mathrm{d} t \\ & = - \frac {1}{3} \ln (t - 1) ^ {2} \left(t + \frac {1}{2}\right) + C. \end{array}
$$

所以方程①两边积分得

$$
- \frac {1}{3} \ln (t - 1) ^ {2} \left(t + \frac {1}{2}\right) = \ln x - \frac {1}{3} \ln C, \text {即} \left(t ^ {3} - \frac {3}{2} t ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2}\right) x ^ {3} = C.
$$

于是，所给微分方程的通解为

$$
\left[ \left(1 + \frac {y}{x ^ {2}}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - \frac {3}{2} \left(1 + \frac {y}{x ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} \right] x ^ {3} = C, \text {即} \left(x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} - x ^ {3} - \frac {3}{2} x y = C.
$$
